Subject: Before I touch the framework

Hi Tenzin,

You said to start with tutorials, but I am trying something different first. I spent two evenings just reading what problem this web framework was made for. Turns out it exists because everyone kept rewriting the same pieces: talking to a database, handling a page request, sending back HTML. It has a small number of main parts: routes, models, templates. I drew them as a map on one page with arrows. Now when a tutorial says "add a route", I know which box it belongs in. Is it silly to go slowly at the start? I feel less lost than last time.

Gopika

qa.a: Tenzin had advised starting with tutorials, so Tenzin may be surprised at the slower start, but the map explains why later tutorials will make sense.
